verdict.rationale: Figma has a built-in agent that generates design directions, searches files, and lets teams riff with it inside the product. A community report says its AI summarized notes and data into slides. That counts as in-product AI suggestions, but nothing documents analysis of user data or an insights feature. Missing for 10: documented AI insights or analytics over user data, first-party docs describing data-driven suggestions, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond one anecdote.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use the Figma agent to generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more.
Anyone can edit designs and riff with the agent to refine.
Teammates and AI agents work in the same space with shared context. Generate new design directions, refine, and align—together.
a friend used it to input notes/data and have its AI summarize them into presentation-worthy slides
